Observed bird beaks and feet, including short, pointed, curved, and webbed features.
Linked a short beak with eating seeds and webbed feet with swimming.

end.parentNote: Atharv practised describing beaks and feet and linking these features to feeding and movement. They used the method of looking closely and checking by watching what an animal does. They first mixed up examples of birds, then later correctly described a kingfisher’s long, pointed beak and webbed feet. At home, look at one bird or animal together and ask Atharv to name one feature and explain how it helps.
